decks.notes: The main concept of this combo-storm deck is to quickly generate mana with rituals and fast mana sources like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal, while digging for key combo pieces like Tendrils of Agony or Ad Nauseam with card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, before going off with a lethal storm count to win the game in one explosive turn. The deck is designed to be fast, resilient, and efficient at executing its powerful combo win condition.

The focus of this deck is to rapidly generate mana and card advantage using Elves to combo off with cards like Glimpse of Nature and Green Sun's Zenith. By utilizing creatures like Elvish Reclaimer and Wirewood Symbiote to ramp up mana production with Gaea's Cradle, the deck aims to quickly assemble a game-winning board state. Additionally, cards like Natural Order and Craterhoof Behemoth serve as finishers to overwhelm the opponent with a massive amount of creatures. The deck also features disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe to disrupt opposing strategies.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Narset, Parter of Veils helps to limit the opponent's card draw, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder ensure consistency in drawing answers. The deck aims to maintain a stable board state through efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, while also having the option to close out the game with Shark Typhoon.

This Legacy Aggro deck utilizes the Death & Taxes strategy by disrupting opponents through taxing effects like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth, while applying pressure with creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Stoneforge Mystic. The deck also focuses on using Flicker effects to gain value from enters-the-battlefield abilities and using Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a Companion allows for additional value through blinking multiple permanents. The deck aims to control the game while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through a combination of land destruction and recursion. It utilizes cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration to generate value from the graveyard, while also using cards like Endurance and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's win condition revolves around assembling the Dark Depths/Thespian's Stage combo or using Urza's Saga to tutor up powerful artifacts like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale or Shadowspear. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and out-control the opponent by leveraging the power of its lands.

This UWx Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck focuses on controlling the game through efficient removal and countermagic, while also generating value through cards like Expressive Iteration and Snapcaster Mage. The win conditions include Monastery Mentor, Murktide Regent, and efficient beats with creature threats. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent until it can establish a dominant position and close out the game.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly in order to cast multiple spells in a single turn, leading to a powerful combo finish. The deck includes cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Rite of Flame to accelerate mana production, along with cards like Burning Wish to tutor for key combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Ad Nauseam and Tendrils of Agony allows the deck to quickly overwhelm opponents with a storm of spells, while protection cards like Veil of Summer and Defense Grid help ensure the combo is successful.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands effectively. The deck includes cards that allow for quick land ramping and graveyard recursion, as well as key lands such as Dark Depths and Field of the Dead. The deck also includes cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The combination of control elements and powerful lands makes this deck a formidable opponent in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing Goblin creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and card advantage. It includes various Goblin creatures with abilities like haste, mana ramp, and card search to maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, cards like Food Chain and Muxus, Goblin Grandee provide powerful combo potential for explosive turns. The deck aims to win by establishing a strong board presence early in the game and maintaining pressure to finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal while generating card advantage with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Expressive Iteration. The deck also aims to stabilize the board with powerful threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Monastery Mentor. With a mix of efficient removal spells and potent threats, this deck aims to out value and out maneuver its opponents in a slow and grindy game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games.

This deck aims to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while applying steady pressure through aggressive creatures. It utilizes powerful white creatures like Mother of Runes, Thalia, and Skyclave Apparition to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also efficiently tutoring for key pieces like Aether Vial and equipment to support its creatures. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Sanctum Prelate helps to deal with threats while maintaining pressure on the opponent. Overall, this deck focuses on creating a disruptive aggro strategy that can overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

This deck focuses on playing threats early and protecting them while disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes cheap and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also packs a punch with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast. The goal is to apply pressure quickly and efficiently while controlling the opponent's resources with cards like Brazen Borrower and Wasteland. The deck aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on generating massive amounts of mana with Elves and using Gaea's Cradle to power out explosive plays. It utilizes cards like Glimpse of Nature and Green Sun's Zenith to draw through the deck quickly and find key combo pieces like Natural Order and Craterhoof Behemoth to win the game in a single turn. The deck also has disruption in the form of Collector Ouphe and Archon of Valor's Reach to disrupt the opponent's strategies while maintaining its own game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board control and put pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. Utilizing cheap spells like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Lightning Bolt, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up its own board presence. With a mix of counterspells like Daze and Force of Will, as well as removal like Forked Bolt and Pyroblast, this deck aims to maintain tempo and control the pace of the game while dealing consistent damage to the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence. It also features a mix of powerful planeswalkers, such as Jace, the Mind Sculptor, and versatile creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The inclusion of cards like Sylvan Library and Narset, Parter of Veils further enhances the deck's ability to draw cards and control the opponent's resources. The mana base is tuned to support the deck's powerful spells and adapt to various matchups.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of disruption and powerful creatures to outvalue the opponent. By utilizing cards like Endurance, Grief, and Opposition Agent, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating advantage through cards like Elder Gargaroth and Meren of Clan Nel Toth. The deck also incorporates the Nic Fit strategy of utilizing Veteran Explorer to ramp into bigger threats like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Henrika Domnathi. Overall, this deck seeks to dominate the game through a combination of strong creatures and disruptive spells.
